summary: This March 10, 2026 escalation lecture is already-public Strategy source spine for the control-beats-dominance mechanism: weapons dominance can become strategically inferior when the weaker actor has better calibration, timing, justification, and option control.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Control is more important than dominance because the strongest weapon does not decide who manages timing, options, legitimacy, and escalation.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Strategy page already anchors this source in the durable dominance/control lens point, and the episode read already links the core source mark to that point.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the mature formulation of the Dominance Is Not Control section. Jiang's cafeteria-bully model turns escalation into a control problem: the actor with less raw force can win by preserving options, making the stronger actor justify each rung, and manipulating the bully into self-destruction.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns the mechanism when control means escalation management, timing, force limits, and enemy adaptation. Do not split a standalone Control Beats Dominance page while the parent page remains legible.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as background pressure for Hormuz-as-dial and systems-pivot material: Iran can tax, exempt, reward, and punish ship by ship, turning the strait into a calibration surface rather than a simple open/closed switch.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Chokepoint owns gates, routes, energy, food, trade, and access-control surfaces. Strategy remains the parent when the question is the general law that control beats dominance.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the source as escalation-ladder comparison only when revising the Iran-war child page: the stronger state can be manipulated into ground troops, overreaction, and rungs it does not want because reputation and dominance make non-response costly.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: No-Exit War owns war momentum and exit-cost rungs. The dated prediction branches should not be merged into a single fulfilled-or-failed ledger item.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep the three explicit forecast claims as separate active-watch material before any ledger promotion: American ground troops, no nuclear weapons, and eventual destruction of Al-Aqsa. The source itself frames the wager as falsifiable.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns dated claim comparison, status, falsifiers, and later revisions. Strategy owns the mechanism Jiang uses to make the wager.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-03-10, this lecture sharpens the April 2024 Operation True Promise dominance/control problem and the June 2025 escalation-dominance trap into the explicit rule that control is more important than dominance.

The source dates the wager to 2026-03-10 and states three branches together, but downstream review should keep them separate: ground troops/draft or invasion pressure, non-use of nuclear weapons, and Al-Aqsa destruction during the war.

next_actions.action: No public Strategy prose mutation or episode read JSON repair is needed now; the page already cites this source at lens-point:control-beats-dominance, and the episode read already links the core mark to that lens point.

Do not create standalone Control Beats Dominance, Escalation Control, Cafeteria Bully, Hormuz Dial, New Kid Strategy, Destroy Iran, Saudi Chaos Strategy, Heartland Trade, Ground Troops, No Nuclear War, or Al-Aqsa Prediction pages from this source alone.

If downstream synthesis follows, prefer Strategy replacement/compression only if Dominance Is Not Control grows too dense after comparing predictive-history-xeepoxqdu5e, predictive-history-n4cs-8mrp-s, and predictive-history-fz-dan7nrss.
If prediction work follows, split and compare the March 10 branches with the March 12 Law of Eschatological Convergence and March 12-April active-watch material before promotion or scoring.
